about: GamesOMG Item Spawner test fixture (0.3.0, extended for 0.4.0): every GroupData of The Planet Crafter, read from the game files offline (resources.assets + sharedassets*.assets: the GroupDataConstructible / GroupDataItem fields). constructibles: id -> [has icon, recipe ingredients, inventorySize, secondary inventories, groupCategory, {world unit: unitGeneration} (non-zero), chip-linked (some item's unlocksGroup is it), lootRecipeOnDeconstruct]; items: id -> [has icon, equipableType, unlocksGroup (target id or null)]; english: the English name of every chip's target (GROUP_NAME_ in the game's CSV). 26411416 = v2.104 (public); 26763323 = the Magnetaris preview (v2.202). Made by make_fixture.py from the dumps of dump_groups.py.
